validation_results.failure: The static-capture policy allowed the qualified lead to remain in battle just above its generic 35% recovery threshold, after which a legal Snorlax damage roll fainted it during the bounded capture attempt.

diagnosis: The capture planner checked catcher safety before every action, but the Snorlax adapter reused a generic low-health threshold that did not reserve enough health for the opponent's free turn after a failed throw. Earlier schedules caught Snorlax in one to six throws and never exercised this longer hostile damage sequence.
repair_direction: Use a conservative static-capture survival threshold before every weakening hit or throw, retain the bounded healing reserve, improve failure telemetry, replay the exposed seed, and preregister disjoint fresh cohorts.
